args.question: Fizz mid versus Ahri, Qiyana jungle, Mordekaiser top, Xayah bot, Karma support, draft-only concise plan
claims: Ahri's Orb of Deception pressures Fizz early, and Fizz can dodge Charm with Playful / Trickster.
Ahri's Charm cooldown is 12 seconds at all ranks.
Ahri can use Spirit Rush to dodge Chum the Waters.
Qiyana has Supreme Display of Talent as her ultimate.
Ahri can Charm Fizz as he lands from Playful / Trickster or during Urchin Strike.
Ahri tends to control the early wave against Fizz.

turns.text:
Lane: Ahri misses Orb of Deception: **step in** for a short trade; save Playful / Trickster for Charm.
Kill: Ahri's Charm misses and her health is low: **commit**; until then, hold pressure and farm.
Threat: Qiyana approaches near terrain: **keep Playful / Trickster** for Supreme Display of Talent.
Fights: Xayah uses Featherstorm: **wait**, then enter on her once she lands.
Win: Ahri answers your side wave: **take the free window** to move toward Graves.
Edge: Ahri still has Spirit Rush: **bait it before casting Chum the Waters**.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide : Trick of the Tails
results.snippet: Early-game, Fizz is quite weak so you have a slight advantage there. You will want to try and harass him with Orb of Deception and auto attacks as much as possible, but make sure that you do not use Charm until he uses his Playful / Trickster or else you'll likely never hit it. … In many cases, you may have to use your ult to dodge his ult too if you see it coming towards you. … The best way to play against a Fizz is to try and poke him down early-game and get a small lead from your only window of advantage, but for the most part you need to play safe.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide : -Temptations of the Fox-
results.snippet: When facing Fizz, you have to wait for him to initiate. If you use Charm to try and engage, he can easily dodge it with playful/trickster and then jump to you with Urchin Strike and you'll have no way of escaping. … His ultimate has a travel time, so you can attempt to dodge it with a charge of Spirit Rush. … Against this match-up, you must poke him down as much as possible, otherwise he'll destroy you once he hits 6.

results.title: Fizz Build Guide : Let's go Fishing!
results.snippet: But normally Ahri will just push against you early and take the lane control from there, but if she messes up you can win … If she uses her Q/E to farm go harass her at that time since she can’t really fight back.

data.answer: Poke Fizz early with Orb of Deception and autos, but save Charm until after he uses Playful / Trickster; use Spirit Rush to dodge Chum the Waters. Fizz can dodge Ahri’s Charm with E and punish her, while Ahri’s ultimate can evade his E and R; Ahri may push early and control the wave.
